content:
BUILT CoLAB presents here one of its members, A400!

A400 is an engineering company with 25 years of activity, working in the areas of design, consultancy, supervision, inspection and diagnostics, supported for this purpose by companies within its group, such as Buildgest and DTWay.


It champions an innovation policy that includes cross-cutting modernisation, the development of skills and the acquisition of advanced and innovative technologies for project development, and the continuous development of a highly conceptually skilled team.


Continuous improvement is a crucial tool for controlling and improving the efficiency of our working processes, as well as for increasing the satisfaction of the needs and expectations of clients and other stakeholders, with the company holding an Integrated Quality, Environment and Social Responsibility Management System, accredited to the ISO 9001:2015, NPEN 14001 and NP4469-1 standards.


A400, mindful of the strong dynamic it has observed in the market since its founding in 1995, has made urban regeneration interventions in public spaces a priority, making it a challenge in the design and development of projects that contribute to sustainable urban development, based on the social and environmental balance of the built environment and the economic revitalisation of urban centres, ensuring the mobility, safety and diversity of the population.


The multidisciplinary approach to specialties in building renovation through BIM technology makes it possible to gain competitive advantages in terms of increasing the profitability and quality of processes.


The origin and driving force of the BIM process within A400 aim for continuous improvement of the production process, with BIM technology seen as a crucial tool for the efficient management of our procedures and working methodologies, as well as for promoting the satisfaction of the needs and expectations of our clients.
